svg.title: Roof Supplement Value Bands
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-roof-supplement-value-bands; chapter number: 4; title: Roof Supplement Value Bands; subtitle: Reported supplement sizes from advertised average to single-spot O&P; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: $2,500 to $7,000 per approved supplement (Roof Sales Mastery), with a single file lifted about $26,000 (Estimate Mastery); buckets: label: Advertised Average Supplement; low: 2500; high: 2500; notes: Roof Sales Mastery's advertised figure; label: Real Average Supplement; low: 4000; high: 4500; notes: Roof Sales Mastery's figure across contractors trained since 2014; label: Top User Average; low: 5000; high: 7000; notes: Some Roof Sales Mastery users using the 100-plus item master list; label: O&P Riding on One Closet Spot; low: 5400; high: 5600; notes: Chad Michael's $28,000 job where a single interior water spot unlocked O&P; caption: Estimate Mastery took a $21,027 RCV file to $47,192 RCV with O&P, while American Roof Supplements aims for the most accurate, supportable estimate at $150 per supplement.; assumptions note: Bands are each practitioner's own reported figures and are not drawn from a common sample of claims.; note: Attributed to Roof Sales Mastery, Chad Michael, Estimate Mastery and American Roof Supplements.
